purpose: Establish the admissible source boundary for the next Idukki stateful-reservoir evidence layer.

current_official_schema.idukki_level_unit_quirk: The generic table header says metre, while Idukki's MWL/FRL cells are explicitly marked in feet. Dynamic Idukki water-level values must therefore carry a row-level feet override when the same row exposes the ft convention.

ending_date_rate_balance_diagnostic.assumption_for_diagnostic_only: The flow rate published on a report date represents the preceding 24-hour interval.
ending_date_rate_balance_diagnostic.interpretation: The consecutive official rows are internally close under the ending-date convention, but the residual is not assigned to evaporation, diversion, rounding or another physical term without source documentation.

mirror_erratum.reason: Historical mirror records contain demonstrable schema/column-shift artefacts, including percentage- and feet-suffixed values appearing in the stored inflow field on some 2024 dates. Fixed-position historical extraction is therefore not sufficiently reliable for model admission across schema changes.

previous_v1_4_dam_safety_pair_timing_sta.2025-03-17_to_2025-03-18: date-level official pages verified, but not admitted as strict SLDC daily inflow
previous_v1_4_dam_safety_pair_timing_sta.2025-02-19_to_2025-02-20: mirror-only timing weights remain secondary until the exact official pages are recovered
